source_text: WE HAVE LOST MANY LIVES, WE'VE MADE MANY SACRIFICES, AND THE CHURCH HAS GROWN COLD. THE GOSPEL IS CAUGHT BETWEEN THE SWORD AND A WALL. BUT WE HAVE A TREMENDOUS OPPORTUNITY TO SHARE THE GOSPEL WITH OUR OWN PEOPLE. - RÓMULO SAUÑE
line: Text on screen: We have lost many lives, we've made many sacrifices, and the church has grown cold. The Gospel is caught between the sword and a wall. But we have a tremendous opportunity to share the Gospel with our own people. Rómulo Sauñe.
notes: Opening quote, white on black, lines fade in 0:00-0:18.

line: Seen from above, dry brown hills fold around a wooded ravine.
notes: Over Quechua speech (OK per narrator).
Title over aerial hills 0:33-0:45. Over Quechua speech (OK per narrator).

line: A green valley of farm fields below high mountains.
notes: Over Quechua speech (OK per narrator).

line: A steep green peak rises into the clouds. Below it, stone ruins spread across terraces.
notes: Peak 0:54-1:09, ruins from 1:06. Not named by the film so far. Over Quechua speech (OK per narrator).

line: A llama by a stone wall. In a dark kitchen, two women tend a fire.
notes: Llama 1:12, kitchen 1:15. Over Quechua speech (OK per narrator).

line: He was a leader, and a martyr.
notes: condensed subtitle

line: The Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve,
notes: condensed subtitle

line: and give His life to rescue many.
notes: condensed subtitle
